page.content:
Ansatsuken master who taught Ryu and Ken to reject the killing intent.

How Gouken connects

  • Concept: Ansatsuken — Gouken teaches the non-killing form of Ansatsuken.
  • Character: Ryu — Gouken trained Ryu in Ansatsuken.
  • Character: Ken Masters — Gouken trained Ken Masters beside Ryu.
  • Character: Akuma — Akuma struck Gouken down with the Raging Demon.

What is Gouken?

Gouken is the brother of Akuma and teacher of Ryu and Ken. He forbade the Satsui no Hadou, then appeared to die at Akuma's hands before returning in later games.

Key threads lead to Ansatsuken, Ryu, Ken Masters and Akuma.
